flags.summary: The party has tried the mist wall at the road's east edge and heard each other's reasons for coming (arrival.dialogue). Guards the hook scene.
The arrival played at the wolves, the party never having looked back at the mist; it goes on to the wolves.
The party has studied the wolf-killed deer once (one Survival attempt only).
Survival at the carcass showed the wolves are a patrol, not hunters. Unlocks an easy Insight option at the wolf standoff.
The wolf standoff in the narrows is over (talked down or fought). Removes the wolf NPC that blocks the road.
The party faced the wolves down without a fight. Read by narration and banter; Strahd's wolves have reported a party that doesn't scare (Village/Phase 4 may read).
The party killed the wolf pack on the road (encounter mists_wolves). Read by narration and banter; Phase 4 may read.
The Gates of Barovia have opened for the party (door flag). Read by the gate statues' narration.
Under Speak with Animals, the crow at the village edge told the party that the two children in the road have no smell at all (Rose and Thorn are the house's illusion).
